draft.title: The goal and objectives of the WHO
card: The World Health Organization (WHO) is the United Nations agency for health. Its goal is the highest possible level of health for everyone.
Universal health coverage
All people can get the health services they need without suffering financial hardship.
Health emergencies
The WHO helps countries prepare for, detect and respond to outbreaks and other emergencies that threaten health.
Healthier populations
The WHO works to promote health and prevent illness across whole populations, not only to treat people once sick.
draft.remember: The WHO aims for the highest possible health for all, through coverage, emergency response and healthier populations.

a.q: Which of these best describes the WHO's goal?
opts: The highest possible level of health for everyone
Treating only the sickest people in poorer countries
Ending poverty in all countries by 2030
a.why: The WHO aims for the highest possible health for everyone. Ending poverty is a different goal, and the WHO does not mainly run hospitals or treat only some groups.
a.clue: Look for the option about everyone's health.

b.q: A new infectious disease appears in several countries. The WHO helps the countries to detect cases and respond. Which WHO objective is this?
b.why: Helping countries detect and respond to an outbreak is the health emergencies objective. Universal health coverage is about access to services without hardship, and healthier populations is about promoting health and preventing illness more broadly.
b.clue: The scenario describes a sudden threat spreading across borders.

a.best: The highest possible level of health for everyone

problems.detail: The clue 'Look for the option about everyone's health' points straight to the only option that mentions everyone's health, so students can answer without knowing the WHO's goal.

a.q: Which of these best describes the WHO's goal?
opts: The highest possible level of health for all people
Basic health care for people in low-income countries
An end to poverty and hunger in every country by 2030
Running hospitals and clinics in all member countries
a.why: The WHO's goal is the highest possible level of health for all people, not just a basic level for some. Ending poverty and hunger by 2030 is part of the wider Sustainable Development Goals, and the WHO supports countries rather than running their hospitals.
a.clue: Ask whether the goal is limited to some people or to a basic level.
